study: Five fresh independent simulated beginner mouse-only RILL composition attempts after latest-main rebase

protocol.study_type: Five fresh independent simulated beginners, not a human user study
protocol.agent_context: Fresh fork_turns=none tasks; no previous feedback, source code or peer sessions provided
protocol.task: Compose a 30-second piece using audio plus MIDI through a VST instrument, save the project and export WAV and MIDI using only a mouse. Give the piece a chosen name if possible. Before exporting, use the Mixer to balance the audio and MIDI track volumes and pan, try mute and solo, and create a bus and send if you can discover how.
protocol.comparison_note: Rounds7and8 use the same five musical personas, task, mixer follow-up, report questions, mouse driver, viewport and lab audio configuration. Earlier rounds did not explicitly ask for mixer exploration, so their ratings are historical context rather than a controlled comparison. Elapsed time includes screenshots, tool overhead and reporting pauses; it is not a human performance or hardware latency benchmark. Each cycle uses a separately frozen validated build.
protocol.inputs: Only screenshots plus logged click, double-click, drag, drag_hold, down, up, scroll and pointer move. No keyboard input, project injection or source inspection during attempt.
protocol.reset: Five new native windows on :881–:885, empty caches and fresh working directories. No projects or preferences from prior participants. Settings seed only 48 kHz / 1024 frames. Unmodified production starter audio and byte-identical native Rill Lab Sine VST3.
protocol.rating_scale: 1–5; higher means more of the named quality. Higher confusion is worse.
protocol.audio: Per-session timer-paced PulseAudio virtual sink via ALSA bridge at48kHz, Rill requested1024 output frames and PULSE_LATENCY_MSEC=60. No physical hardware or listening claims. Shared host, software graphics and virtual backend can affect responsiveness; this is not a latency benchmark.
protocol.validation: Independent read-only verification of saved project ZIP, embedded audio, native VST assignment, MIDI events and WAV samples; isolated analysis copies rendered with frozen binary to check actual audio and VST mix contributions. Original outputs remain unmodified.
protocol.reporting: Observable action/reaction summaries, screenshots and timestamped mouse logs, not private reasoning transcripts.
protocol.frozen_build: Native executable and adjacent plugin helper frozen only after coordinator confirms validation; git HEAD/main, staged+unstaged source diff, untracked source archive, full source hashes and executable hashes recorded.
limitations: No window manager; native dialog placement may differ from desktop installations.
Only the native laboratory sine VST is included; no third-party compatibility claims.
Audible quality is not assessed unless explicitly auditioned and documented.
fixed_questions: Did you complete and save the requested piece?
Did WAV and MIDI export show success?
Which mixer tasks could you discover and complete: volume, pan, mute, solo, bus, and send? Report the visible result or blocker for each attempted task.
What actions were easy or difficult, and what visible evidence supports each observation?
Rate ease, appearance, speed, confusion and feature completeness from1to5, explaining each rating.
What remains unverified, including heard audio and file contents?

build_conditions.comparison_note: Round7 and round8 use the same compiler/profile settings. Earlier rounds used debug-info builds; do not infer platform performance gains from cross-round timing.

participants.persona: Independent simulated beginner, first introduction to RILL, seeking a short relaxed lo-fi sketch.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged audio fader from -6.0 to -8.4 dB and MIDI fader from -2.5 to -12.0 dB; exact numeric values visibly updated. Balance not auditioned.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged pan knobs horizontally; audio showed L10, MIDI showed R14.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked audio Mute during playback; amber highlight appeared. Clicked again to return it off. Meter silence was observed but audible isolation was not verified.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked MIDI Solo; green highlight appeared. Clicked again to return it off. Audible isolation was not verified, and output-stream failure affected this portion of playback.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Add bus; New bus appeared as a separate mixer channel at 0.0 dB routed to Master.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked MIDI Add send, + Send, then New bus. Routing displayed a 0.25x Post send, and the mixer subsequently showed Send New bus, Bus 1 in and connecting route lines.

participants.persona: Independent simulated beginner, first introduction to RILL, interested in a small electronic dance groove.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged both Mixer faders: Circuit drums -6.0 to -7.7 dB, New instrument -2.5 to -6.2 dB. Values remained visible after save. No audible balance claim.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged audio knob left/down to L22 and instrument knob right/up to R26. Labels and knob positions visibly changed.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked Circuit drums Mute on, observed amber outline, then off before saving/export. Playback interruption limits interpretation of sound impact.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked New instrument Solo on, observed highlighted button and active instrument/master meters with empty audio meter, then off before saving/export.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Mixer Add bus; New bus channel appeared with 0.0 dB, centered pan and output to Master. After the send, its subtitle showed Bus 1 in.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked New instrument Add send, + Send, then New bus. Routing showed New bus at 0.25x with Post selected; Mixer showed Send · New bus and routing lines. Left this send enabled for export.

participants.persona: Independent simulated beginner, first introduction to RILL, interested in a short melodic instrumental.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged audio fader from -6.0 to -8.4 dB and MIDI fader from -2.5 to -7.3 dB; both values remained visible in the final arrangement. No listening-based balance claim.
mixer_outcome.pan: Horizontal knob drags changed audio from C to L15 and MIDI from C to R17; final arrangement retained those values.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked audio Mute on and off twice; orange highlighting appeared when on. Restored off before final save. Audible behavior not auditioned.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked MIDI Solo on and off twice; highlighting appeared when on. Restored off before final save. Audible behavior not auditioned.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Mixer Add bus, which created New bus at 0.0 dB routed to Master; after adding the send it displayed Bus 1 in. Bus meter later lit during recovered playback.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked MIDI-track Add send, + Send, then New bus. Routing showed New bus at 0.25x with Post selected, and the Mixer displayed Send · New bus.

participants.persona: Independent simulated first-time RILL beginner interested in a short ambient soundtrack sketch.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged the Circuit drums fader from -6.0 dB to -14.0 dB and New instrument from -2.5 dB to -9.1 dB; numeric values visibly updated.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged audio pan knob left to L20 and MIDI pan knob right to R20; both labels visibly updated.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked Circuit drums Mute during playback; orange active highlight appeared. Clicked again to restore unmuted state.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked New instrument Solo during playback; active highlight appeared. Clicked again to clear solo before export.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Mixer Add bus; a New bus strip appeared with 0.0 dB fader and Master output. Final mixer displayed Bus 1 in.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked MIDI Add send, then + Send, then New bus. Routing displayed New bus, 0.25x level and Post selected; final mixer displayed Send - New bus.

participants.persona: Simulated beginner, first introduction to RILL, interested in a short hip-hop beat with a simple synth part.

mixer_outcome.volume: Dragged Circuit drums fader from -6.0 dB to -4.0 dB and New instrument from -2.5 dB to -7.3 dB. Values remained visible in the final arrangement.
mixer_outcome.pan: Dragged Circuit drums pan knob horizontally left to L15 and synth knob right to R18; displayed values confirmed both changes.
mixer_outcome.mute: Clicked Circuit drums Mute while playback was active; its button became highlighted and its meter was dark in the screenshot. Clicked again to return it off. No audible verification.
mixer_outcome.solo: Clicked New instrument Solo while playback was active; its button became highlighted. Clicked again to return it off. No audible verification.
mixer_outcome.bus: Clicked Add bus; a New bus strip appeared with 0.0 dB, centered pan and Master output. Later showed Bus 1 in after the send was added.
mixer_outcome.send: Clicked the synth Add send button, then + Send and selected New bus. Routing displayed a 0.25x Post send to New bus. Mixer subsequently displayed Send · New bus and a routing line.

comparison_limits: Rounds7and8 add an explicit mixer task absent from earlier rounds; only round7→8 is directly comparable.
Elapsed time includes screenshots and reporting; input events include new held-gesture actions and are not equivalent to physical gesture counts.
Round1 did not explicitly encourage a chosen project name; later rounds did.
Each round evaluates its frozen build; ratings are never retroactively applied to later fixes.
